items: [Utility Design] Our over the toilet storage shelf features three open shelves and 1 storage basket, along with 3 removable hooks and a toilet paper holder, providing ample storage space. [Super Stability] The metal X-shaped frame crossbar and wall fixing nails ensure the safety of the bathroom organizer shelf over toilet , preventing tipping and shaking. The anti-fall basket design allows for secure storage of unstable items. Non-slip feet maintain overall stability and protect the floor from scratches.

[Adjustable and Quick Installation] Featuring three adjustable wooden shelves, you can customize the distance between shelves to accommodate items of various heights, maximizing storage capability. Our 3-tier bathroom organizer shelf over toilet come with a detailed installation guide, including assembly instructions, part configuration numbers, and all necessary tools, making assembly easy and enjoyable.

[Multipurpose Storage Rack] Ideal for small spaces, our over-the-toilet storage rack saves space and maximizes storage capacity. Perfect for bathrooms, living rooms, kitchens, entry halls, laundry rooms, balconies, porches, dormitories, hotels, and offices. It can be used as a storage rack, kitchen shelf, plant shelf, or laundry organizer, providing the perfect solution for small bathrooms or apartments.

[Satisfaction without Risk] Choose Kalrin the-toilet storage rack for an enhanced lifestyle. Our satisfaction warranty ensures a great user experience for a whole year, and our support team is always available to assist you. Make a risk-free purchase with Kalrin today.
